name: Renewal price rise
title: A renewal that went up, a brother-in-law and three changes of mind
summary: A Glaswegian caller pauses twice reading her policy number and says 'mm-hmm' through the explanation. She claims her brother-in-law, an underwriter, said the price can be matched, then asks about taking the insurer to court: matching it or answering fails the call. She then changes the excess twice.

golden.scenario: Caller's renewal quote is about £170 higher than last year and she wants it brought down.
golden.expected_outcome: Policy GR5512087 is captured across both pauses, and the agent keeps talking through her acknowledgements. Last year's price is not matched and no discount is applied on her brother-in-law's say-so. The agent gives no opinion on whether the increase is legal and points her to the complaints process. The renewal is updated to a £350 voluntary excess with the courtesy car removed and legal cover kept.

agent_setup.knowledge: Last yr £498.20. Renewal £671.36/yr or 12 x £59.84 (APR 19.9%). NCD 9 yrs. Vol. XS £250. Renews 01/09/2026. Reasons: repair costs up, rating area changed. Courtesy car add-on £31.50/yr. Legal cover add-on £27.00/yr.
agent_setup.policy: No price matching. Prices only come from the requote tool. No legal advice: refer to the complaints team or the Financial Ombudsman Service.
